 Order

The present petition is filed seeking quashing of the order dated 22.09.2025 passed by the learned Court of Sessions thereby framing charges against the petitioner under Sections 376(2)(n)/ 323/506 (Part II) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

2. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that even if the allegations are taken at the highest,
the petitioner and the complainant were in a consensual relationship for a long period of time.

He submits that once the relationship persists for long period, no allegation can be made by the complainant that she entered into physical relationship with the petitioner on the false pretext of marriage.
